help.title: User Manual & Workflows
help.description: Learn step-by-step how to carry out daily operations, all features of the Aluplan Support platform, and AI modules.

section1.title: Login and Overview
section1.desc: The first screen you see when you log in to the system is the Overview (Dashboard) screen. On this screen:
section1.item1: You can see your active support requests that are ongoing and waiting for a response.
section1.item2: You can quickly access the latest created articles.
section1.item3: You can read the system announcements shared for you from the "Announcements" board.

section2.title: Using the AI Assistant
section2.desc: Before opening a ticket, we recommend using the AI Assistant (/ai) menu to solve your problem quickly.
section2.item1: Click on the AI Assistant tab from the left menu.
section2.item2: Write the error you receive or the topic you want to learn in the message box (e.g., "Program crashes while drawing walls").
section2.item3: AI will scan the entire knowledge base and present the solution steps directly to you. If no solution is found, it will suggest creating a support request.
section2.tip_desc: Since AI uses RAG (Learning Algorithm), you will get more accurate answers if you ask questions by specifying the name of the software modules (e.g., AX3000).

section3.title: Opening and Following a Support Request (Ticket)
section3.desc: To forward the issue to the agents, you can create a new record from the My Support Requests page.
section3.step1_desc: After clicking the New Request button, select the product family you are experiencing the problem with (e.g., ALLPLAN, AX3000). In this way, your request is directly directed to the relevant expert team.
section3.step2_desc: Enter a clear title and details explaining the problem you encountered. Select the urgency level (determined by SLA).
section3.step3_desc: You can upload screenshots, PDFs, or project files (Max 10MB) directly by dragging and dropping.

section1.title: Ticket Management
section1.card1_desc: Requests from all customers are collected on the Ticket Queue page.
section1.card1_item1_desc: You can enter the ticket and change the status from the dropdown in the right panel (Open, Answered, Closed).
section1.card1_item2_desc: Use the Internal Note (Internal Only) tab to take only team internal notes that the customer cannot see.
section1.card1_item3_desc: You can transfer the ticket to a specific expert representative by using the "Assign" button.
section1.card2_item1: Press the "Create AI Response Draft" button at the top right when you enter the ticket.
section1.card2_item2: The system scans the customer's message and your company's Knowledge Pool. By making a vector data match, it prepares a professional draft referring to the relevant documents within 5-10 seconds. You can respond to the customer immediately by approving the draft and editing it according to your own style.

section2.title: Knowledge Pool & Learning Loop
section2.item1_desc: In order for AI to respond, you need to constantly provide new data to the infrastructure. There are 3 ways to do this:
section2.item1_way1_desc: Directly add technical specifications to the database as PDFs. The system divides them into <u>Embedding (Vector)</u> parts.
section2.item1_way2_desc: When you give the current "How to" URL addresses on your site to the system, AI reads your website and saves it to its memory.
section2.item1_way3_desc: You can create an "Instruction" for AI by manually entering frequently asked questions.
section2.item2_desc: When customers vote for closed tickets with 5 stars, the system thinks that the solution is perfect. However, to prevent this solution from being written directly to the main database, it falls into the AI Approvals tab. As an administrator, you can choose to have the solution learned by AI (Approve) or skipped (Reject) in this tab.

section3.title: CRM & Product (Taxonomy) Configuration
section3.card1_desc1: You manage the Product cards that the customer sees when opening a ticket from here. The most important part is Categories and Keywords.
section3.card1_rule_desc: Write not only product features (Wall, Beam) but also customer symptoms (stuttering, black screen, closing) in categories (e.g., Model Crash). AI reads these keywords and directs the ticket to the correct team (Triage).
section3.card2_desc: You can approve Customers and create Support Teams (Departments) from under the SYSTEM menu of the left panel. Do not forget to set the SLA rules (How many hours to respond, should it stop outside working hours?) from the Team Management tab so that tickets can be assigned automatically.
